name: vgi
description: Expose your APIs, application data, and models to DuckDB SQL. VGI (Vector Gateway Interface) connects DuckDB to a worker: a local program or hosted service that publishes SQL tables and functions backed by your code.

cta.title: Turn APIs, models, and code into SQL
cta.description: Attach a hosted worker as a catalog and DuckDB queries it like any other database — discover its schema, query its tables, and join it with your local data.

quickStart.title: Try VGI with a public demo worker
quickStart.description: This demo worker publishes a live earthquake feed, so you can try VGI without writing or hosting anything. ATTACH connects to the worker; SELECT reads a table it provides. Your own workers use the same pattern to expose different data and functions.
quickStart.note: To use your own API or code, [build a worker](/vgi/building-a-worker/) that exposes it, then attach that worker’s location. The worker defines its own tables and functions; `eq.main.recent` belongs to this demo. You can also [try a worker that calls a weather API](/vgi/getting-started/#examples). The earthquake feed changes, so your results will vary.
quickStart.requirements: The embedded browser supports this worker. For native SQL, use a VGI client with protocol 2.2.0 support; older clients cannot attach to this worker. Network access is required.

entryPage.title: VGI: Connect Your APIs and Code to DuckDB SQL

introduction.title: Connect SQL to code running in a worker
paragraphs: A VGI worker defines tables and functions that DuckDB can call. Its implementation might fetch an API response, query an internal service, or run a model. The extension handles the connection; the worker decides how to obtain the data or compute the result.

Attach a worker someone else has published, or [build your own](/vgi/building-a-worker/) using a supported SDK. Its tables and functions can then participate in queries alongside your local data. The public earthquake worker below is one example of that interface; each worker can expose a different set of capabilities.
